observations: Photo 0 shows a used metal engine mount with a central rubber bushing and two mounting lugs with bolt holes, resting on a wooden board.
Photo 1 shows the reverse side with a triangular mounting flange, three bolt holes, and stamped markings including a star-like logo and part-number characters.
Both photos carry a "CHIDI AUTOS VENTURE" watermark.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show an engine mount.
Photo 1 shows a star-like logo but no readable brand name; genuine Mercedes origin cannot be confirmed from the photo alone.
No chassis, fitment, or vehicle-specific data is visible in either photo.

risks.risk: Rubber bushing may be torn, collapsed, or separated from the metal housing.
risks.proof: Close-up side lighting of the rubber-to-metal bond and a compression/squeeze clip.

risks.risk: Metal housing may have cracks or stripped/damaged bolt holes.
risks.proof: Close-up of all mounting ears and bolt threads.

risks.risk: Part may not fit a Mercedes W204 despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the stamped part number alongside a W204 fitment confirmation.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the stamped part number visible in photo 1.
Side view showing the rubber bushing condition and any separation from the metal.
response.reason: The item is visibly an engine mount, so it can be priced at its worst case as a used mount with unproven brand and fitment.
